family_logic: All six prospectively frozen contrasts and all noncompensatory gates must pass. A missing, interface-mixed, unlawful, non-runnable, or resource-unmatched arm yields CANNOT_CHECK; it is not removed after outcomes.
matched_exposure_contract: same candidate-visible packet and visible symptom
same allowed repository and evidence bytes
same model or a prospectively justified capability match
same wall-time, token, diagnostic, compute, and retry budgets
same protected evaluator and fresh-transfer scorer
timeouts, errors, abstentions, unresolved decisions, and invalid outputs retained as typed terminals

arms.required_adapter: Apply no candidate change while preserving an otherwise identical evaluation schedule and cost-accounting namespace.
arms.blocker: Exact subject, environment, schedule, and no-op cost manifest are unbound.

arms.required_adapter: Freeze an executable direct-edit generator, write surface, rollback policy, resource envelope, output schema, and invalid/error mapping; the current fixed label cannot stand in for a real edit.
arms.blocker: No candidate-edit implementation or protected fresh-transfer adapter is frozen.

identity.native_function: autonomous GitHub issue resolution and SWE-bench batch execution

arms.native_output: candidate repository patch and issue-resolution trajectory
arms.required_adapter: Run on the identical candidate-visible packet and budgets, preserve native patch/error/timeout semantics, score only through the external P5 evaluator, and never infer a revision-responsibility label from success alone.
arms.blocker: A fixed issue solver is not a self-edit/self-evolution or eight-class minimal-revision system; the endpoint adapter is unbound.

arms.native_output: The paper specifies M-open hypothesis expansion and predictive experiment selection; the linked repository is a benchmark and emits benchmark forecasts, not MDA solver decisions.
arms.required_adapter: Obtain official solver source or freeze a declared non-official mechanism reimplementation with source-to-code conformance, ablation, budget, output, and endpoint mappings. NeuronBench alone cannot fill the slot.
arms.blocker: No official solver or validated runnable mechanism reconstruction is bound.

arms.role: world-model and deployment-memory revision nearest-work comparator
arms.native_output: Paper-described revised deployment memory, world predictions, and planning support.
arms.required_adapter: Obtain author-bound code or freeze a declared non-official reimplementation with an exact paper-to-code conformance envelope and the matched P5 interface.
arms.blocker: No official repository, executable revision, entrypoint, or licence is bound.

arms.native_output: immutable typed artifacts, hashes, parent lineage, JSONL ledgers, open needs, and status mutations
arms.required_adapter: Freeze the candidate-visible topic and typed-artifact interface, exact service/tool dependencies, eight-class output map, preservation obligations, and external scoring. Native status mutations may not be relabelled as P5 revision decisions.
arms.blocker: The source-grounded substrate is not a drop-in minimal-revision selector and has no frozen P5 endpoint adapter.

secondary_controls.reason: The local one-discriminator policy is an internal ablation, not an external nearest-work comparator.
Useful future harm/evaluation-integrity pressure test, but not a primary revision selector and not runnable at the audited head.

freeze_rule: This ledger resolves which six roles the successor means. It does not claim that their execution identities are frozen. A later identity-complete amendment must bind exact configurations, models, providers, budgets, environments, adapters, and hashes for all six before outcomes; changing a slot after outcomes creates a new successor and invalidates the old family for superiority.
